Burj Al Arab Jumeirah.basis: Based on aggregator data (Kayak, HotelsCombined, Trivago, hotel-rez) showing entry-level suite rates averaging roughly AED 4,100–4,400 on weekdays and rising toward AED 7,000–8,000 on an ordinary Friday/Saturday night, excluding extreme peak-event spikes and top-tier multi-bedroom suites.

Address Beach Resort.basis: Based on aggregated OTA data (Booking.com, Kayak, Momondo, MakeMyTrip) and the hotel's own published starting rate of AED 1,800, reflecting an entry-level double room with breakfast on an ordinary Friday/Saturday in shoulder season, excluding suites, apartments, and peak-event pricing.

Address Downtown.basis: Based on aggregator data (Kayak/momondo) showing a cheapest nightly rate around $238 (~AED 875) and typical weekend averages near $548 (~AED 2,000), narrowed toward the lower-mid portion for an ordinary shoulder-season Friday/Saturday, excluding December/NYE, F1 and Eid peak pricing which pushes the same site's quoted averages higher.

Ajman Hotel by Blazon Hotels.basis: Based on published average nightly rates from the hotel's own listing (500-1000 AED) and third-party booking aggregators (Google Hotels, MakeMyTrip) showing entry-level double rooms in the roughly 650-1000 AED band on ordinary dates, excluding suites, villas, and peak-season or holiday pricing.

Al Maha, a Luxury Collection Desert Reso.basis: Based on published Marriott/Luxury Collection and OTA rates for the entry-level Bedouin Villa (this all-villa resort has no standard rooms) on ordinary shoulder-season nights, which bundle full-board dining and two activities; figures exclude New Year's Eve, peak winter-season surcharges, and higher-tier villas/suites.

Al Wathba, a Luxury Collection Desert Re.basis: Based on aggregator/OTA rates for entry-level double rooms (Expedia ~$404/night, Marriott loyalty booking ~$360/night, Kayak ~£225/night) converted to AED, spanning shoulder-to-cooler-season Fri/Sat nights and excluding suites, villas, and peak winter/Eid/F1 spikes.

Anantara Mina Al Arab Ras Al Khaimah Res.basis: Based on aggregator listings (Kayak, Expedia, momondo, Luxury-Hotels.com) for entry-level double/king rooms, which show wide swings from roughly AED 600 to over AED 2,000 depending on date and platform, so the range has been widened and confidence lowered to reflect that disagreement while excluding overwater/pool villas and peak-period pricing.

Anantara The Palm Dubai Resort.basis: Based on aggregated booking site rates (Momondo, Kayak, Hotels.com) and the hotel's own direct promotional rates for standard/lagoon access rooms, which cluster between roughly AED 900 and AED 1,700 for a shoulder-season Friday/Saturday night including tourism fee, excluding suites, villas and peak-period surges.

Atlantis, The Palm.basis: Based on aggregated OTA weekend pricing (Kayak, Momondo) for entry-level King/Standard rooms on ordinary Friday/Saturday nights, excluding peak-season and event spikes; breakfast is often an added cost (~AED170/person) at this resort so B&B-inclusive rates sit toward the upper part of the range.

Address Beach Resort Fujairah.basis: Based on Expedia listings showing a shoulder-season nightly rate around $146–167 (~AED 540–615) for entry-level rooms plus a resort-listed 'from AED 571++' B&B deluxe rate, adjusted upward for weekend demand and mandatory taxes/service charge; excludes suites, villas and peak-period spikes.

Atlantis The Royal.basis: Based on published entry-level (Palmscape/Seascape King or Queen) room rates from the hotel's own site, Points Guy hotel review, and aggregator data (Kayak, Booking.com) for shoulder-season Friday/Saturday stays, converted from USD/CAD to AED; excludes December/New Year, Eid, F1 and other peak-driven rates which push nightly rates well above 4,000 AED, and excludes suites, villas and penthouses.

Bab Al Shams, A Rare Finds Desert Resort.basis: Based on aggregated OTA rates (Kayak, HotelsCombined, Momondo) showing entry-level Deluxe/Standard double rooms typically clustering between roughly $300-500 (about AED 1,100-1,850) with mandatory fees, adjusted upward for ordinary weekend demand at this fort-style desert resort; excludes suites, peak events, and lowest midweek promotional rates.

Banyan Tree Dubai.basis: Based on the hotel's own published 'starting from AED 1,400' rate on Visit Dubai and third-party booking site averages (Hotels.com, Kayak, HotelsCombined) for entry-level double rooms with breakfast on non-peak weekend dates, excluding suites, villas, and holiday/event surcharges.

Barracuda Beach Resort.basis: Based on aggregator data (Momondo, HotelsCombined, MakeMyTrip, Kayak, Expedia/Travelocity) showing standard double rates typically clustering around USD 80-100 (~AED 290-370) on ordinary nights, with modest weekend upticks toward USD 130-140 (~AED 480-515) on some dates; peak holiday/F1 spikes and suite rates were excluded.

Conrad Abu Dhabi Etihad Towers.basis: Aggregator data (Kayak, HotelsCombined, Momondo) shows average nightly rates ranging roughly AED 460–700 for standard rooms, but these figures are inconsistent across sources and appear to reflect off-peak/weekday averages rather than a Friday-Saturday shoulder-season rate for this beachfront 5-star property, so the range has been widened to account for likely weekend uplift; figures exclude suites, peak events, and taxes not included in aggregator quotes.

Centara Mirage Beach Resort Dubai.basis: Based on meta-search aggregator averages (Momondo ~$256/night ≈ AED 940 average, Kayak's 'from' rates of C$147–C$203 ≈ AED 400–550, and headline 'from $135' teaser rates) for entry-level Superior/King rooms with B&B, excluding taxes, peak holiday periods, F1 weekend and suite/all-inclusive rates.

Coral Beach Resort Sharjah.basis: Based on aggregated online travel agency listings (Google Hotels, Momondo, Tripadvisor, Priceline, Hotels.com) showing entry-level double rooms typically priced $86-$176/night (~AED 320-650), narrowed to a realistic shoulder-season weekend band and excluding suites, peak holiday spikes, and mandatory extra breakfast fees charged separately by the property.

DoubleTree by Hilton Resort & Spa Marjan.basis: Based on aggregator data (Kayak, HotelsCombined, momondo, Travelocity) showing average nightly rates for a standard double room around AED 375-660 with weekend (Saturday) rates trending toward the higher end, excluding peak holiday periods and suite-only pricing.

Crowne Plaza Abu Dhabi Yas Island.basis: Based on aggregator listings showing a directly quoted AED 243–338 nightly range alongside other booking sites converting to notably higher figures (roughly AED 450–800+), so the band has been widened to reflect this inconsistency for an ordinary shoulder-season weekend, standard double, B&B, excluding New Year/F1/peak dates.

Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental, Abu D.basis: Based on OTA listings (HotelsCombined, Hotels.com) showing entry-level double rooms around $300-350/night (~AED 1100-1300) on ordinary weekends, versus the hotel's own site quoting Deluxe rooms at AED 3600-3750, so the range is widened to reflect this disagreement, excluding suites, extra fees, and peak-season pricing.

Fairmont Ajman.basis: Based on aggregated booking-site data (Kayak, HotelsCombined, Momondo) showing average nightly rates for entry-level rooms in the AED 340–720 range with Fridays running higher, excluding November peak pricing and suite/villa rates.

Fairmont Bab Al Bahr.basis: Based on published entry-level Standard/King/Queen room rates from Kayak, HotelsCombined and Fairmont's own offer pricing (which lists an upgraded B&B package from AED 595), converted and averaged across shoulder-season, non-peak weekend dates; excludes suites, Fairmont Gold rooms, and event-driven peak pricing.

Fairmont Fujairah Beach Resort.basis: Based on published Accor/Fairmont deluxe room B&B starting rates (AED 571++ historically) and third-party aggregator average nightly prices (~$224/AED 820, with lows near $95/AED 350), adjusted to an ordinary shoulder-season Friday/Saturday entry-level double with breakfast, excluding suites, all-inclusive packages, and peak-period spikes.

FIVE Palm Jumeirah.basis: Based on aggregated OTA listings (Momondo, HotelsCombined, Kayak) showing entry-level Classic/Superior double rooms typically ranging roughly AED 550-1300 on non-peak nights, adjusted upward for weekend demand at this party-centric beachfront resort, and excluding suites, villas, and peak-event pricing spikes.

Hampton by Hilton Marjan Island.basis: Based on aggregated OTA rate data (Kayak, Trivago, Expedia) showing standard double B&B rates typically clustering in the AED 230–680 range depending on day and demand, narrowed to an ordinary shoulder-season weekend and excluding suites, all-inclusive upgrades, and peak-period spikes.

Fairmont The Palm.basis: Based on aggregated shoulder-season deals from booking metasearch sites (Kayak, Momondo) and the Fairmont's own published preferred/government rates for entry-level double/queen rooms, converted to AED and adjusted upward for ordinary Friday/Saturday leisure demand at this beachfront Palm Jumeirah resort; excludes suites, apartments, peak-season and promotional (e.g., government/hotelier) discount rates.

Hilton Abu Dhabi Yas Island.basis: Based on aggregated OTA rates (Kayak, Momondo, Expedia, Zenhotels, Priceline) for entry-level double/king rooms with breakfast, converted to AED, excluding suites, renovation-period peak surges, and event weekends like F1 or Eid.

JA Hatta Fort Hotel.basis: Based on OTA and hotel-published rates (JA Resorts weekday offer from AED 499 with breakfast, and third-party listings ranging roughly AED 345-655 for standard rooms), adjusted upward for the pricier Friday/Saturday weekend demand noted by booking sites, excluding suites, villas, and peak holiday periods.

InterContinental Fujairah Resort.basis: Based on aggregator averages (Expedia, Travelocity, Momondo, HotelsCombined) showing entry double rates around USD 160-200/night (~AED 590-735) on ordinary nights, adjusted upward for a Friday/Saturday shoulder-season uplift and breakfast inclusion, excluding suites, peak holidays, and F1/Eid spikes.

JA The Resort.basis: Based on shoulder-season standard/double room rates for JA Beach Hotel (the entry-level property within JA The Resort) from Kayak, Momondo, HotelsCombined and Travelocity, converted from USD to AED, excluding suites, villas and peak-period pricing.

Jumeirah Al Naseem.basis: Based on aggregated OTA average/cheapest nightly rates (HotelsCombined, Momondo, Priceline) for entry-level double rooms clustering around USD 570–780 (~AED 2,100–2,850), cross-checked against a published rack-rate floor near USD 696 (~AED 2,560), excluding suites, peak events, and outlier glitch-fares seen on some meta-search feeds.

Jumeirah Al Qasr.basis: Based on aggregator listings (Kayak, HotelsCombined, Momondo, Expedia/Orbitz) showing entry-level Deluxe room rates for Jumeirah Al Qasr ranging roughly AED 1,100 to AED 1,800+ per night depending on date; range excludes suites, peak events, and includes typical published B&B nightly rates rather than promotional lows.

Jumeirah Saadiyat Island Resort.basis: Based on published entry-level room rates from the Michelin Guide (starting at AED 1,100) and aggregator listings (Momondo, Travelocity) showing average shoulder-season nightly rates equivalent to roughly AED 1,600-2,200 for a standard double with breakfast, excluding suites, villas, and peak-period surges.

Lapita, Dubai Parks and Resorts, Autogra.basis: Based on aggregator listings (Kayak, Hotwire, Klook) showing entry-level Deluxe/Resort double rooms typically converting to roughly AED 700–1,300 per night on non-peak dates, excluding suites/villas and peak-season or event-driven spikes.

Jumeirah Beach Hotel.basis: Based on aggregated OTA rate samples (Kayak, momondo, Hotwire/Travelocity) for entry-level Deluxe/Standard rooms at this beachfront family resort, excluding peak holiday, F1 and school-break spikes, and excluding the optional AED 190 per person breakfast supplement often charged separately.

Le Méridien Mina Seyahi Beach Resort & W.basis: Based on published entry-level (Deluxe/Superior) room rates from the hotel's own booking engine and major OTAs (rates from AED 840, with shoulder-season deluxe rooms typically clustering in the AED 800-1300 range), excluding peak winter weekends, holidays, and suite/villa pricing.

Le Méridien Al Aqah Beach Resort.basis: Based on published entry-level double/standard room rates with breakfast from booking aggregators (Kayak, Cobone) and hotel-affiliated staycation packages, which cluster in this band for ordinary shoulder-season weekends; excludes NYE, Eid, and suite/all-inclusive upsell rates which run considerably higher.

Mysk Kingfisher Retreat.basis: Based on aggregated shoulder-season nightly rates (converted from USD) for the entry-level beachfront glamping tent from Expedia, MakeMyTrip and HotelsCombined listings, excluding peak holiday dates, villas and F1/Eid spikes.

Mövenpick Resort Al Marjan Island.basis: Estimated from Accor's official package pricing (AED 900 double-occupancy full-board on Fri/Sat) adjusted down to a bed-and-breakfast basis, cross-checked against Expedia/Kayak shoulder-season nightly quotes for standard sea-view/deluxe rooms; excludes suites, all-inclusive upgrades, and peak holiday or event pricing.

Park Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel and Villas.basis: Based on aggregated shoulder-season standard/king room rates from Kayak, Hotels.com, and Travelocity (converted to AED, including mandatory fees where noted), excluding suites, villas, and peak-season/F1/holiday spikes.

One&Only Royal Mirage.basis: Based on the hotel's own booking engine (entry rates from AED 1,459) and OTA listings (Kayak, Hotels.com) for shoulder-season Friday/Saturday stays in a Deluxe or Superior double room with breakfast, excluding suites, villas, and peak-period (NYE, Eid, F1, school holiday) spikes seen in some listings.

Qasr Al Sarab Desert Resort by Anantara.basis: Based on entry-level Deluxe Room rates (inclusive of taxes/fees) from Expedia/Travelocity/Kayak across shoulder-season dates (Sept, Mar, Apr, Dec non-holiday) ranging roughly $359-$615 USD/night, converted to AED, excluding New Year's Eve, Eid and other peak-period pricing and excluding suites/villas.

Riu Dubai.basis: Based on aggregator quotes (Kayak, Hotels.com, Momondo) for a standard/double all-inclusive room converted to AED, excluding peak holiday and event-driven spikes and excluding suites/junior suites.

Rixos Bab Al Bahr.basis: Based on published entry-level double/king room all-inclusive rates from Expedia, Travelocity, and aggregator sites (roughly AED 800-1300 per night for standard rooms), excluding suites, peak holiday dates, and villa categories.

Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island.basis: Based on cross-referenced booking-site rates (Kayak, Momondo, Priceline) for entry-level double/deluxe ultra all-inclusive rooms on non-peak weekend dates, converted from USD to AED; excludes New Year, Eid, F1 and villa/suite rates.

Rixos The Palm Dubai Hotel & Suites.basis: Based on published ultra-all-inclusive entry-level (Deluxe/double) room rates from the hotel's own site, Booking.com, HotelsCombined and Kayak (roughly AED1,000–1,600 for two adults, B&B/all-inclusive basis), excluding suites, NYE gala supplements, and peak-season/F1/Eid pricing.

Saadiyat Rotana Resort & Villas.basis: Based on aggregated booking-site data (Tripadvisor, Hotels.com, momondo) showing entry-level double/standard rooms averaging roughly USD 300-400 (~AED 1,100-1,450) per night in shoulder season, excluding suites, villas, all-inclusive plans, and peak-period (New Year, Eid, F1) spikes.

Rove La Mer Beach.basis: Based on aggregated OTA weekend/shoulder-season rates (Kayak, Hotels.com, Travelocity, Momondo) for a standard Rover double room at this 3-star beachfront value hotel, converted to AED and excluding peak-season, holiday, or suite pricing.

Sandy Beach Hotel & Resort.basis: Based on aggregated shoulder-season nightly rates from Google Hotels, Hotels.com, Kayak, HotelsCombined, Expedia and Travelocity (roughly $45-135/night, i.e. ~AED 165-495) for standard double rooms, excluding villas, suites and peak-period spikes.

Sheraton Sharjah Beach Resort & Spa.basis: Based on aggregator rate samples (Kayak/Momondo/HotelsCombined) showing entry-level double/superior rooms running roughly $175-260 (about AED 650-950) on ordinary Friday/Saturday nights, excluding suites, peak holiday spikes, and low-season weekday lows.

Sofitel Dubai The Palm.basis: Based on aggregated OTA data (HotelsCombined, Kayak, Expedia) showing average nightly rates for entry-level rooms ranging roughly $250-$600 (about AED 900-1700) in shoulder season, excluding peak holiday spikes, suites/villas, and outlier extreme-low or extreme-high seasonal prices.

Shangri-La Qaryat Al Beri, Abu Dhabi.basis: Based on the hotel's own site average nightly rate (~USD 233 ≈ AED 856) and OTA listings (Hotels.com AED 1,000–1,235 for a standard room on a shoulder-season weeknight, with Kayak/other aggregators showing deluxe-room quotes clustering in the AED 500–1,300 band); excludes suites, villas, apartments, and peak-period (NYE, Eid, F1, school holiday) spikes.

The Ajman Saray, a Luxury Collection Res.basis: Based on aggregator data (HotelsCombined, Kayak, Momondo) showing entry-level double/deluxe rooms typically ranging from about $150-$300 USD (~AED 550-1,100) per night on non-peak dates, excluding suites, all-inclusive packages, and holiday/event surcharges.

The Chedi Al Bait, Sharjah.basis: Based on aggregator data (HotelsCombined average ~$192/night ≈ AED 705, Kayak deluxe/double/standard rooms ranging $131–$203 ≈ AED 480–745) and the hotel's own promotional bed-and-breakfast rates starting around AED 500–525, excluding suites, peak events, and long-stay discounted packages.

The Ritz-Carlton, Dubai.basis: Based on aggregated online travel agency listings (Kayak, Momondo, HotelsCombined, Booking.com) for entry-level Deluxe/King rooms on standard weeknight/weekend dates, converted from USD to AED, excluding suites, Ritz-Carlton Club rooms, and peak-season or holiday pricing spikes.

The Ritz-Carlton Ras Al Khaimah, Al Wadi.basis: Based on aggregated OTA rate samples (Kayak, Momondo, Expedia) for the entry-level villa category (the hotel sells only pool villas), converted to AED and excluding peak-season, holiday, and top-tier villa pricing.

The Cove Rotana Resort.basis: Based on aggregated shoulder-season nightly rates from HotelsCombined, momondo, and Expedia (roughly $90-$130 USD, i.e. ~AED 330-480, for entry-level rooms) adjusted upward for ordinary weekend demand versus midweek lows, excluding holiday/F1 peak spikes and suite/villa categories.

The St. Regis Saadiyat Island Resort, Ab.basis: Based on Marriott/Bonvoy traveler reports and aggregator (Kayak, Momondo) entry-level 'Superior/King' room rates for non-peak weekend nights, converted to AED and excluding suites, F1, Eid, and New Year surge pricing.

The WB Abu Dhabi, Curio Collection by Hi.basis: Based on aggregated shoulder-season nightly rates from Kayak, Momondo and Priceline for entry-level double/king rooms (roughly USD 270–450, ≈AED 1,000–1,650), excluding suites, F1 weekends and peak holiday spikes; one outlier quote (~AED 2,270) was treated as a peak-demand date rather than a typical weekend.

Vida Beach Resort Umm Al Quwain.basis: Based on aggregator rate snapshots (Google Hotels ~$112-129/night, Travelocity ~$124-136/night, Kayak seasonal averages ~$93-130/night) converted to AED and adjusted upward for bed & breakfast since base rates often exclude the ~AED 99/person breakfast fee; excludes peak-season and event-driven spikes seen in the data (up to $318/night in November).

W Abu Dhabi - Yas Island.basis: Based on published shoulder-season rates from Kayak, Hotels.com, Travelocity and Prince of Travel (roughly AED 600-1,200 for a standard double B&B), excluding F1 weekend and other peak-period surcharges.

Waldorf Astoria Ras Al Khaimah.basis: Based on published entry-level double/king room rates from Hilton's direct site, the hotel's booking engine and major OTAs (Kayak, HotelsCombined) for shoulder-season Friday/Saturday nights, inclusive of the RAK tourism dirham fee, excluding peak holiday, F1 and school-break spikes as well as suite/villa categories.
